title: Holocaust survivor, London-born rabbi and 10-year-old girl among victims of Bondi beach terror attack
summary: At least 16 people including one of the alleged gunmen died at the shooting in Sydney on Sunday, aged between 10 and 87 Follow the latest live updates on the Bondi beach shooting Bondi terror attack: full report What we know so far about the Bondi terror attack At least 16 people were killed and more than 40 wounded when gunmen fired on a Hanukah celebration in Bondi beach, which Australian police and officials are describing as a terrorist attack. title: Troubled Louvre museum in Paris faces disruption as unions call strike
summary: Weeks after jewel heist, world’s most visited museum in dispute over staffing, renovations and ticket price rises Trade unions at the crisis-hit Louvre museum in Paris will begin a strike on Monday to demand urgent renovations and staffing increases, and to protest against a rise in ticket prices for most non-EU visitors, including British and American tourists. The world’s most-visited museum – which has had a difficult few months after a jewel heist , a damaging water leak and safety fears over a gallery ceiling – could face days of partial or total closure at one of its busiest times of the year if many of its 2,100-strong workforce vote to continue striking.
